description: GSTJ shared Renovate preset. Consume with "extends": ["github>GSTJ/magic"], which Renovate resolves to this file. Presets must live in default.json — serving one from renovate.json is deprecated.

packageRules.description: Dev dependencies are not shipped to users; let them merge themselves once CI is green.
Non-major bumps automerge everywhere. Majors always get a human.
oxlint and oxfmt move fast and rules appear/disappear between minors. Group them and never automerge — a new rule can fail every repo at once.
The magic-* packages are the shared tooling. They land together so a config bump can't outrun the plugin it needs.
GitHub Actions pinned by tag; group so a PR isn't opened per action.
TypeScript majors change emit and rule behaviour. Human review.
Expo SDK dictates react/react-native/metro versions. Refresh inside declared ranges only; SDK jumps are done by hand.
react-test-renderer must match the installed react exactly or @testing-library/react-native refuses to run. React's version comes from the Expo SDK.
